notes.title: It's time to update the fans!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Warchiefs!

 

Today’s a good day! I’ll be speaking on behalf of the studio, but first, let me introduce myself: I’m Francis, the new community manager at Fika. As one of the studio’s co-founders, I’ve been part of Fika since we started back in 2018. If you’ve played Ship of Fools (our first game), you’ve definitely seen my work, from editing trailers to crafting islands and combat encounters across the seas.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011308/644b8d61150d25c497164e18a305921fb7e7dbf9.png"]

My goal is to bring more transparency between Fika and you, the fans. There was some oversight on our end in the past years, and I am currently working on ways to improve all our channels of communication, including Steam. Since the campaign ended, we’ve kept things pretty secretive about the game’s progress. There have been lots of small positive changes since what was first shown, and it’s time to get you up to speed!

 

To avoid overwhelming you with a giant, headache-inducing update, we’ll be rolling out news in weekly ‘Warchief Journals’ for the next four weeks. This way, we can chat about each change together and collect your thoughts for the team. We’ll start with the art style, then move on to the game’s story, mechanics around orcs, and finally, the general gameplay loop.

 

Because it’s our first time adopting a more transparent communication style, we’ll begin by sharing updates in the exclusive Kickstarter Discord Channel starting next week. This way, we can fine-tune our approach before communicating it to everyone, two weeks later.

 

So you. YES, YOU! Have you pledged on Kickstarter at the Magician tier or above? You still have time to use one of your rewards: access to the exclusive Kickstarter Discord Channel! So far, only 15% of all backers have joined us on Discord. It’s the best place to connect with the team! If you don’t have a Discord account yet, start by creating one. Then, click the link below to join our private server.

 

https://discord.gg/fika-productions 



You can claim your Discord role in any channel by using the chat command "/kickstarter". You then have to enter the email address linked to your Kickstarter account. For those who have pledged for access to the private channel with the devs, you’ll gain access after redeeming your role.



Not interested in using Discord or unable to access the exclusive Kickstarter Discord Channel? No problem! We know Discord isn’t everyone’s cup of tea. The Warchief Journals will be posted two weeks later on our Kickstarter, our main Discord channel, and of course here on Steam.

 

After these updates are released, we’ll shift to a monthly schedule. Each month, we’ll post a Journal that covers recent updates, changes, and what’s ahead for the game.

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011308/c40478dada6fc924a628bbf9dbc8c62988d54cc7.png"]

That's it! As you join our Discord and get ready for next week, enjoy this small preview of some fresh enemy designs!

 

Cheers!

notes.title: Teach orcs how to feel in Don't Kill Them All!
notes.content:
What if we Don't Kill Them All

Skulls pile up, but the coffers are empty. Blinded by their constant destructive urges, the Orcs leave nothing standing in their wake. A simple raid for wood quickly turns into a massacre and clear-cutting. Something has to change, and fast.

In Don’t Kill Them All, you assume the role of a self-proclaimed Life Coach with an extraordinary solution : What if… WE DON’T KILL THEM ALL?

A new game?
After the success of our first game Ship of Fools, we invite you to live a new adventure in this turn-based strategy and base-building game in which you teach bloodthirsty Orcs to develop mindfulness by discovering passions, navigating emotions, and developing healthy relationships!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011308/93679711e2fcafa6629fd180159d25a632bb55c7.png

Kickstarter!
It would mean the world to us if you show your appreciation for our work by backing our game! You can also wishlist it now on Steam to stay in the loop. We’ve put a lot of care into it and we’re sure you’ll like it a lot!

To back our project on Kickstarter
To watch the trailer on Youtube

And remember: DON’T KILL THEM ALL
